posts.headline: Championshipsovercoochie just went 8-2 and the African Bald Fraud conspiracy is officially a cold case — mjwithgoldhoops' 1402.42 points-for is the best in the league and nobody's catching him.
posts.detail: Two seasons, a 15-13 career record and an average 4th-place finish used to make this slander believable; now it's just denial. 8-2 at a league-high 1402.42 points speaks louder than any nickname.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's Put it in Ra has fallen to 3-7, and a 20-8 career record with a 1.5 average finish is now officially unrecognizable from the team on the field.
posts.detail: This is the best resume in Busters Anonymous history — two finals appearances — reduced to 1070.78 points-for and a losing record. The gap between pedigree and performance has never been wider.

posts.headline: Thicks' Klint's Clipboard moved to 7-3 but 1092.54 points-for is still an embarrassment for a reigning champion — the ring keeps cashing checks the scoreboard can't cover.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Peacemakers 🙏 held steady at 8-2 with 1382.02 points-for, and Bubble Guts is now putting together the best season of his career without a single accident to show for it.
